## Outlook Therapeutics Fireside Chat from H.C. Wainwright Conference Now Available On-Demand


September 11, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.outlooktherapeutics.com/node/12991/pdf)


*Fireside chat featuring Bob Jahr, Chief Executive Officer, and H.C. Wainwright Managing Director & Senior Biotechnology Equity Research Analyst*


*Access the video webcast*[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=oj5qQtY6K-5_AslrGgQ1q2V_AJGC_HJQZYIfORr0lSJISmMJQq8YLkVB3SscLAyyxDsd-LgF-H3myl_gAOmp-d9XKAc5gOxkhOFWYWsRMnrG55yGG4Jx2P_xAbGJjRGiogk7R8Av7mXXXeh7neshTQ==)


ISELIN, N.J., Sept. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Outlook Therapeutics, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=V8XCPeU2r75c0ygWJvBgB4R5fuDX4m8seDTdAmY0UmPJ1pKOUa0qJYx4B-0vVK5xnLmyfOEoVuGXebKMbDjNSn8wN_48owo-x5WFtAZmKLY=) (Nasdaq: OTLK), a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of LYTENAVA™ (bevacizumab-vikg, bevacizumab gamma) for the treatment of retinal diseases, today announced that its pre-recorded fireside chat from the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference (the “Conference”) is now available for on-demand viewing[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=oj5qQtY6K-5_AslrGgQ1q5GtxdOi66z7aGMWxCgCHp9MhqjUkE-AfuthfgmAdEZzEshg_zT-tGmoBj4imtYVjflRv6EKg18NqxEyeCc4lLZT7zW5Sp7RZcaIHYVTEPNrbWUaHDq3YJHkNKVSq_xAUQ==) .


The fireside chat features Bob Jahr, Chief Executive Officer of Outlook Therapeutics, and Douglas Tsao, Managing Director and Senior Biotechnology Equity Research Analyst at H.C. Wainwright, discussing the Company’s recent developments.


The[on-demand presentation](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=TbDyEFPk1NDwnYIOuYJv6wvL_OWvB7sRB9FaQUfbD4HMuoPkZRDUKmd3dPL6AmEm2A6RyvyhwUWJg_7L6S7PZzles0q95PhFvv7BaRJ7XSZ2SfHQLfag5Nz6jmQzfoDMa1D3-Jv5bk-yKZaYPzv_sNbJ92s365j5QalsqtdO5XU=) is available for viewing beginning today, September 11, 2026, at 7:00 a.m. ET, and can be accessed through the[News & Events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=JcYENbX_y1mGrzIqkdY8z2b6EtIMXi5NNDulsYTHyltaekEdkJXscvjPwsaxKE2TY7M_xkOmv55xOf-a-D8P0sTIa-hlifxJudqFWho-HsYuzwkh3qNe13NHkj8gS6lhSGa3YGQ0K8Qbmp5ZvGxoPg==) page on the[Investors](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=zbPmKgz9NzUUVa81gU_qxUswl_vJlRYQLP6IPAiVZ08du7jBvgNl_EdontPqPwpk23dWjk9dIrI3sgItotd3fRhqON70PJ-tKSovmOgHjYo=) section of the Company’s website ([outlooktherapeutics.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=a2zwlMG3HAWdesRmbUKME-LqwE7M6z3VUFwOoYMSh55AjqBD0V0AdZB6cUqkHvfbcAXqehpAF1tqssiijnKlJZqI1NHc39xsI-4Sv12oattoTqx5fcjZesGjTmVnykaT) ).


Management will be available on-site at the Conference being held September 14-16, 2026, in New York, NY, to participate in one-on-one meetings with qualified members of the investor community who are registered to attend the Conference. For more information about the Conference, please visit the[conference website](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=qoVg-gRdwSXbJTzlPS7EieFPEVP6d3pDcIGViagr0pLQIn-loT8A8TuY5aKNiBTjIYR-Rj2W-KGFzNI2S5UbCpQC0kbQXfOUBGmNq2R6WBZxHZacRdvDN0eJ7o_GoGfU) .


**About Outlook Therapeutics, Inc.**


Outlook Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of LYTENAVA (bevacizumab-vikg (U.S.), bevacizumab gamma (E.U.)). LYTENAVA is the only ophthalmic formulation of bevacizumab to receive U.S. FDA approval and European Commission and MHRA Marketing Authorization for the treatment of wet AMD. Outlook Therapeutics commenced commercial launch of LYTENAVA (bevacizumab gamma) in Germany, Austria, and the UK as a treatment for wet AMD.
